prompt:
CAMERA / LOOK: Handheld mini DV camcorder footage filmed by the subject herself. Slight hand shake, occasional focus hunting, imperfect framing, natural zoom adjustments, soft tape-like image quality, subtle grain, realistic auto-exposure shifts from bright open-park daylight. Natural skin tones, mild motion blur, authentic consumer camcorder aesthetic.
STYLE: Cozy outdoor break vlog with gentle ASMR elements. Relaxed pacing, minimal dialogue, candid moments. Focus on satisfying sounds: paper wrapper unwrapping, bench creaking, leaves rustling in the wind, light chewing sounds.
SUBJECT: Young man in his mid-20s, plain t-shirt, cap, hair short, no visible logos or branded items. Calm, easygoing energy during a short pause outdoors.
SETTING: Small park bench under a tree on a bright afternoon. Natural daylight, open grassy background, no visible signage or brand names in frame.
STORYBOARD:
→ (3s, propped medium shot) Places camera on the bench armrest, sits down. "Taking a little break before heading back."
→ (3s, close-up) Unwraps a plain sandwich from paper.
→ (3s, handheld shot) Takes a bite, looks out at the open grass. "Needed this."
→ (3s, detail shot) Leaves rustling gently in the breeze overhead. No dialogue.
→ (3s, warm ending shot) Wipes hands, relaxed smile at the camera. "Back to it now." Hand covers lens as recording ends.
AUDIO NOTES: Natural ambience — wrapper unwrapping, leaves rustling should be clearly audible. Dialogue quiet and casual.
REALISM NOTES: Authentic body language, natural blinking, genuine easygoing smile, imperfect framing, focus breathing, bright daylight shifts. No copyrighted characters, logos, brand names, or recognizable public figures anywhere in frame. Fully original personal vlog content, not AI-generated or commercial in style.
